product_launches.description: Kubecost, a U.S.-based Kubernetes cost management software firm, launched Kubecost 2.0 in January 2024, a cloud-agnostic platform that enhances real-time cost visibility and optimization for complex multi-cloud Kubernetes environments.

overview_description.description: Kubecost is a developer of a cost monitoring platform to help companies manage their Kubernetes resources and costs. Its platform also provides direct integrations with the Kubernetes API and cloud billing APIs, cost allocations for all key Kubernetes concepts, dynamic recommendations for optimizing cloud spend, and infrastructure assessment services helping clients to reduce spending and prevent resource-based outages.

product.description: An open-source Kubernetes cost allocation tool for measuring resource consumption and attributing cluster costs to workloads, teams, namespaces, and other Kubernetes entities.
